questions.q: What does 'Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt' mean?
options: I used to live in the city
I rarely live in the city
I will live in the city
At the moment I live in the city
questions.explain: 'Zurzeit' means 'at the moment / currently', so this is 'At the moment I live in the city'.
'Herunterladen' means 'to download' (literally 'to load down'). 'Hochladen' is 'to upload'.
'Der Klimawandel' means 'climate change' (Klima + Wandel = change).
'Erneuerbare Energien' means 'renewable energy' (e.g. wind and solar).
'Das Schlagzeug' means 'the drum kit' (from 'schlagen' = to hit).

questions.q: How do you say 'My phone battery is empty'?
questions.explain: 'Der Akku' = 'the battery' and 'leer' = 'empty'; 'voll' (full) is the trap.
'Packen' = 'to pack' and 'die Koffer' = 'the suitcases', so this means 'to pack the suitcases'.
'Die Umwelt' means 'the environment' (nature/planet), as in 'die Umwelt schützen' = 'to protect the environment'.
'Der Stadtrand' means 'the outskirts/edge of town'; 'die Innenstadt' = centre.

questions.explain: 'Speichern' means 'to save' a file or data on a computer.
'Die Werbung' means 'advertising/adverts'.
'Das Fernsehen' means 'television'; the remote control is 'die Fernbedienung'.
'Die Fußgängerzone' is the 'pedestrian zone/precinct' (from 'Fußgänger' = pedestrian).

questions.q: What does 'Ich interessiere mich für Musik' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich interessieren für' means 'to be interested in', so this is 'I am interested in music'.
'Die Innenstadt' means 'the town/city centre'; 'der Stadtrand' is the outskirts.

questions.q: How do you say 'In my free time I often play chess'?
options: In meiner Freizeit spiele ich oft Schach
In meiner Arbeit spiele ich oft Schach
In meiner Freizeit höre ich oft Musik
In meiner Freizeit spiele ich nie Schach
questions.explain: 'Die Freizeit' = 'free time/leisure' and 'Schach spielen' = 'to play chess'.
'Die Gegend' means 'the area/region/neighbourhood', e.g. 'eine ruhige Gegend' = 'a quiet area'.
'Sich sonnen' means 'to sunbathe' (from 'die Sonne' = sun).

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football'?
questions.explain: 'Fußball spielen' = 'to play football'. 'Klavier spielen' would be 'to play piano'.
'Der Untertitel' means 'the subtitle' (e.g. on films); 'die Überschrift' = headline.
'Der Verein' means 'a club/society', e.g. 'der Sportverein' = sports club.
'Die Verpackung' means 'the packaging' (wrapping that often becomes waste).
